paper: Immervoll, Kleven, Kreiner & Saez (2007), The Economic Journal 117:1-44 - Welfare Reform in European Countries
note: Shipped repo contained only EUROMOD.xls, cached CSV sheet exports, and prep_checks/check_table2a.py. All 7 table/figure driver scripts named in the plan were absent and were written from scratch (welfare_core.py + 6 run_*/plot_* scripts), re-implementing eqs (15),(16),(18),(19) exactly as encoded in the shipped prep check. Writing these scripts is counted as the per-step 'fix'.

step_outcomes.description: Set up environment; inventory EUROMOD.xls; run shipped prep check prep_checks/check_table2a.py.
step_outcomes.command_executed: uv venv /workspace/.venv && source activate && uv pip install xlrd numpy scipy matplotlib && python3 prep_checks/check_table2a.py
step_outcomes.stdout: 15 country rows printed, e.g. 'AT -0.38 3.04 -0.08 1.5 shares 0.37 0.5' ... 'UK -0.22 1.88 -0.01 1.06 shares 0.47 0.6'. Workbook exposes all 20 sheets: Read Me, Aggregate Run, Disaggregate Run, Tax-Benefit Data_1998, 15 country sheets, WeightsGermany.
step_outcomes.notes: Dependencies installed cleanly (numpy 2.5.3, scipy 1.18.1, matplotlib 3.11.2, xlrd 2.0.2). Prep check runs with no missing-sheet/file errors and its 15 rows already match paper Table 2(a). GPU present but not needed (lightweight closed-form algebra).

fixes_applied.description: Wrote Step-5 driver using a 10x10 group-x-decile eta with the female profile on groups 2,4,6,8,10.

step_outcomes.notes: Panel (a) reproduces Table 2(a). Panel (b) matches paper Table 6(b) closely (DK demogrant 28.10 vs 29.09, ~3% on a near-singular trade-off; all other cells within rounding). The plan's expectation that WP trade-off is below demogrant in EVERY panel-(b) country is NOT met for FI/IT/SW -- and the paper's own Table 6(b) agrees (FI 4.65>4.10, IT 1.84>1.82, SW 6.21>4.30), due to their compressed earnings distributions. Reported faithfully; see suspicions.json S1.

step_outcomes.notes: Both PDFs rendered and visually verified (3 panels each, deciles 1-10, labelled lines per country). Patterns match paper: Nordic high marginal rates rising with decile; DK participation tax falls from ~77% to ~60% across deciles. Per plan, these are the shipped EUROMOD-computed tax-rate inputs (EUROMOD cannot be re-run from restricted micro-data in this container).
